top_signals.title: Li Ka-shing Keeps Ports Sale’s Price Tag Despite Panama Loss
top_signals.summary: Li Ka-shing’s CK Hutchison Holdings Ltd. expects to sell what remains of its global ports portfolio for its original $22.8 billion value, even after losing two Panama terminals that had been included, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Italy to request EU defense loan after all, but scales back amount
top_signals.summary: Italy has requested €8 billion euros ($9.3 billion) in cheap loans from the European Union’s SAFE program following earlier doubts about the move.
